value_invariance_argument: With the pair fixed, target values (T_l', T_h') replace (T_l, T_h) by ECI' = T_l' + k (ECI - T_l) in every draw of both fits, k = (T_h' - T_l')/(T_h - T_l) > 0 a constant; means, quantiles and widths map by the same k, so the S2 ratio |dmean|/W0 and the S3 ratio Wk/W0 are unchanged, Spearman of means (S1) and within-draw orders (S4) are unchanged.
